name: Gauntlet USDT Prime V2
oneLiner: Gauntlet USDT Prime V2 is a Gauntlet-curated Morpho V2 USDT lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDT-denominated idle balances and lender positions in Gauntlet-curated Morpho markets, including loans secured by WBTC, cbBTC, wstETH and sUSDS. Borrower collateral secures the loans rather than being held directly by the vault; custodial-BTC, collateral-valuation and market-liquidity risks remain. Shares are not direct claims on Tether reserves.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDT for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDT and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets. VaultV2 deliberately returns zero from maxWithdraw and maxRedeem as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. The current adapter force-deallocation penalty is 0.01%, separately governed from ordinary withdrawal accounting.
